ex.s: And until all of humanity, without exception, undergoes a metamorphosis, wars will continue to be waged, and everything that has been carefully built up, cultivated and grown will be cut down and destroyed, only to start all over again!
ex.t: 直到全人类无一例外地经历蜕变，战争将继续进行，一切被精心建立、培育和成长的东西都将被砍伐和摧毁，只为了重新开始这一切！

ex.s: The memory of those seven will live forever, written in the stars, inspiring us to join them in humanity’s greatest journey of exploration and discovery.
ex.t: 这七个人的记忆将永远长存，写在星星中，激励我们加入他们，踏上人类最伟大的探索和发现之旅。

ex.s: Read the quotes and answer the questions The sole meaning of life is to serve humanity.
ex.t: 阅读下面的名言并回答问题：生命的唯一意义是服务人类。

defs.def: the state of being a person rather than a god, an animal or a machine 人性
the quality of being kind to people and animals by making sure that they do not suffer more than is necessary; the quality of being humane 人道；仁慈
the subjects of study that are concerned with the way people think and behave, for example literature, language, history and philosophy 人文学科

ex.s: She explains we are at a “tipping point” in history and must act now to prevent an extinction-level event for humanity.
ex.t: 她解释说，我们正处于历史的“临界点”，必须立即行动，以防止人类遭遇灭顶之灾。

ex.s: If you want to tell the history of the whole world, a history that does not privilege one part of humanity, you cannot do it through texts alone, because only some of the world has ever had texts, while most of the world, for most of the time, has not.
ex.t: 如果你想讲述整个世界的历史，一部不偏袒任何一部分人类的历史，你就不能只依靠文字文献，因为世界上只有一部分地区曾经有过文字，而世界上大部分地区在大部分时间里都没有。

ex.s: What humanity is concerned about.
ex.t: 人类关心的是什么。

defs.def: showing you do not think that you are as important as other people 谦逊的；虚心的

ex.s: While taking a 20-hour train ride along the edge of the Taklimakan Desert in northwestern China, I had the kind of humbling, educational, and above all else, wonderful   41   with a local that all travelers long for.
ex.t: 我们获得了所谓的是非观念。

ex.s: Tom has been awarded several prizes, but this teenage innovator remains humble.
ex.t: Tom已经获得了几个奖项，但这位年轻的创新者仍然谦虚。

defs.def: （表示谦逊，但不够诚挚或认真）

ex.s: It is in places like these that we cannot help but be humbled, come to understand our limitations as human beings, and know that our duty is to protect them for future generations.
ex.t: 正是在这些地方，我们不禁感到谦卑，开始理解我们作为人类的局限性，并知道我们的责任是为后代保护它们。

defs.def: having a low rank or social position （级别或地位）低下的，卑微的
not large or special in any way 事物
to make sb feel that they are not as good or important as they thought they were 贬低；使感到卑微
to easily defeat an opponent, especially a strong or powerful one 轻松打败（尤指强大的对手）
to show that you are not too proud to ask for sth, admit that you have been wrong, etc. 低声下气；谦逊；虚心
an animal or plant that has parents of different species or varieties 杂种动物；杂交植物；杂种

ex.s: So while some of the world's first coins were made from a naturally occurring hybrid of gold and silver called electrum, objects other than coins have served as currency, including beads, ivory, livestock, and cowrie shells.
ex.t: 在整个殖民时期，烟草在弗吉尼亚州、马里兰州和北卡罗来纳州被用来代替硬币或纸币，尽管它在殖民地其他地方以及整个欧洲和英国也被广泛使用

defs.def: something that is the product of mixing two or more different things （不同事物的）混合物，合成物

ex.s: Yuan Longping 1 ____________to do research on hybrid rice because natural disasters 2____________food shortages in the 1960s.
ex.t: 袁隆平开始研究杂交水稻，因为20世纪60年代自然灾害导致了粮食短缺。

ex.s: WORKING THE LAND A PIONEER FOR ALL PEOPLE Yuan Longping, known as the “father of hybrid rice”, was one of China’s most famous scientists.
ex.t: 《耕耘土地：全民的先驱》——袁隆平，被誉为杂交水稻之父，是中国最著名的科学家之一。

ex.s: Yuan was convinced that the answer could be found in the creation of hybrid rice.
ex.t: 袁隆平确信答案可以在杂交水稻的培育中找到。

ex.s: A hybrid is a cross between two or more varieties of a species.
ex.t: 杂交种是一个物种中两个或多个品种的杂交。

ex.s: One characteristic of hybrids is that they usually attain a higher yield than conventional crops.
ex.t: 杂交品种的一个特点是它们通常比传统作物获得更高的产量。

defs.def: a vehicle that uses two different types of power, especially petrol/gas or diesel and electricity 混合动能车（使用两种不同能源，尤指汽油或柴油与电混合使用）
a chemical element. Hydrogen is a gas that is the lightest of all the elements. It combines with oxygen to form water. 氢；氢气

ex.s: Together, they thought outside the box and broke new ground, leading to the breakthrough of the hydrogen bomb.
ex.t: 他们共同跳出思维定式，开辟了新天地，促成了氢弹的突破。

ex.s: As a major breakthrough for China in the field of astronomy, its key functions are to survey neutral hydrogen in space, observe pulsars and track and communicate with spacecraft.
ex.t: 作为中国在天文学领域的重大突破，它的关键功能是勘测太空中的中性氢、观测脉冲星以及与航天器进行跟踪和通信。

ex.s: I had no idea what hydrogen was, and I didn't really want to know, either!
ex.t: 我不知道氢是什么，而且我也不真的想知道！

ex.s: For example, liquid hydrogen is a clean alternative energy source that is used widely as rocket fuel, and it is likely that hydrogen fuel cell vehicles will be mass-produced and launched in the near future.
ex.t: 例如，液态氢是一种清洁的替代能源，被广泛用作火箭燃料，而且氢燃料电池汽车很可能在不久的将来大规模生产并推出。
